scope: Member Workplace experience, existing Calendar-owned Rooms experience, and admin09 location catalog UI implementation
evidence_basis: Frontend Playwright journeys use mocked authorized native API responses. Production code calls the real owner APIs; screenshots do not prove live production data or backend PostgreSQL behavior.
material_behaviors: Native Workplace create success navigates with the server-confirmed actual bookingId to /workplace/my-bookings?booking=actualID. Unknown outcomes never automatically navigate or resubmit; manual identical intent reuses the native idempotency key.
Booking and relocation completion callbacks reject a changed actor, target, open/reopen generation, or unmounted scope. Catalog and team mutation scope also tracks generations.
Team plans disclose only persisted opt-in choices allowed by tenant policy and verified returned group refs; shared plans are planned location, and actual presence remains explicitly unverified.
Admin catalog uses actor-scoped site/floor/resource reads, hides retained data on403, and supports readonly keyboard selection, responsive map/list, and real selected-space inspector.
Floor-plan placement edits continue through the existing governed draft/review/publish/restore owner. Current catalog projection does not directly publish a new floor plan.
Authorized period closures affect queried Explore availability, resource bookability, relocation candidates, and home available counts without mutating global resource state.
Actual resource photo/media and facilities components are root-owned consumers; missing registered photos display an icon. Photo retry controls are siblings of the resource selection button.
Existing Calendar-owned policy, booking, approval, range, authority, and version contracts remain in use. Policy changes are reviewed before native versioned save.

text_resize_method.method: At the stated CSS viewport width, Playwright executes document.documentElement.style.fontSize = '200%'. This resizes root-font-relative text; it is not native browser zoom, CSS zoom, page scaling, or device-pixel-ratio scaling.
text_resize_method.assertions: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth; serious/critical Axe checks where present; home additionally checks a computed root-font-relative day-brief text size increase.
text_resize_method.limitation: Fixed-pixel text may not scale with root font size. No proof of native browser200%zoom or universal doubling of all text is claimed.
text_resize_method.root_lane_640_css_reflow: Root admin/governance specs separately include640CSSpx viewport reflow (1280/2). That is viewport reflow and does not itself prove native browser200%zoom; not rerun by this member lane.
text_resize_method.historical_checkpoint_note: The root-font200% artifacts belong to earlier own responsive checkpoints, not the final five-case Home run. Root genuine native browser zoom2 and DIP measurements are separate root evidence and were not performed by this lane.
